title: Kagamine Len — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Len and Rin's anniversary
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it should be okay now, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Um, Kanade...
And everyone... Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Thank you for taking me shopping on my anniversary...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Besides, we're the ones who should be thanking you. This'll make for a nice break.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why are you looking at me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you're the one who needs it the most.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: By the way, where's Rin? It's also her anniversary. I thought we were going to look for a gift together...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cake...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They're taking you shopping because you don't know what you want, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I've already decided, so I don't need to go.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Rin would like cake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There're so many different kinds, though...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's where we come in, isn't it? We should be able to pick a cake to Rin's exact preferences!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu? What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Look over there. Len's on screen.

rows.Speaker: Ena, Len & Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh?
<Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Hello everyone! It's me, Kagamine Len and...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Kagamine Rin!
You haven't forgotten our anniversary event today, have you?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <In the chat segments, we'll be interviewing each other!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You'll also be able to watch it on livestream, so I hope you can make it!>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Alright, we'll be waiting on stage!>

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: <See you later!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, you meant the Rin and Len over here.
I freaked out when you said Len was on screen.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Um... I didn't know the me in your world is having a celebration too.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. It seems like they do it every year.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I know that it's a different version of me, but... I'm happy for him.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really are kind, Len.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's now time to go get a gift for our Len!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Wow... There's so many CDs. I wouldn't know which one to pick.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: In that case, let's pick something based on the cover! Shall we try that out?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hmm... I made my choice after imagining what sort of cover you would like, Len, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, yours has a photo on it.
Mizuki's and Ena's have illustrations, and Mafuyu's...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is super simple! I would've never thought they'd just have the album title on a plain white cover.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We're supposed to be picking something as Len's potential gift. You could've picked something cuter.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But everyone said to just pick one that seemed interesting...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's not like it gets cold in SEKAI... But do you like these kinds of faux fur scarves or hats?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Faux fur?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's a type of fabric that mimics the texture of animal fur with different materials.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey Kanade, explain to Len what sort of texture it is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Wait, me?
Um...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's soft, shiny... And smooth?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh! I was just fooling around, but you totally nailed it!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Soft, shiny and smooth...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Since we're already here, let's go buy one of these and have you feel it.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, you're back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't know you were here too, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rin! We got a super delicious-looking cake for you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kind is it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on one sec. I'll open it for you now.
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you find something you like, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. Oh, um... Everyone picked a CD based on the jacket for me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Each person picked a CD, and then I got to pick the one I liked the most.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Looks like Len had fun. I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! Rin said she wants to have the cake!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a little early in the day for that, but...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess we shouldn't keep one of the stars of the day waiting either. Shall we just go ahead and start celebrating now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
